cards.sentence_translation_zh: 内分泌门诊常处理甲状腺、肾上腺和胰岛素相关疾病。

cards.meaning_en: the study of mind and behavior (psych- mind + -logy study)
cards.usage_note: psych- 是心智，-logy 是学科。词根是研究心理过程，不等于精神科诊断，更不能只靠构词给人贴病名。
cards.context_sentence: Medical psychology helps students talk with frightened patients.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Training about the mind helps students speak with patients who are scared.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 医学心理学帮助学生与恐惧的患者交谈。

cards.meaning_en: the study of disease processes (path- disease + -logy study)
cards.usage_note: path- 是疾病，-logy 是学科。词根是“研究生病过程”。口头说 pathology 有时只指化验科，不能只靠构词。
cards.context_sentence: General pathology describes how inflammation damages tissue after infection.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The disease-process course explains how swelling after infection can harm tissue.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 病理学描述感染后炎症如何损伤组织。

cards.meaning_en: the study of living things (bio- life + -logy study)
cards.usage_note: bio- 是生命，-logy 是学科。词根很宽，细胞、遗传、生态都算；课堂说 medical biology 仍不能只靠构词当专科。
cards.context_sentence: Cell biology is the starting point for later histology and physiology.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The study of living cells comes before later courses on tissues and body function.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 细胞生物学是后续组织学和生理学的起点。

cards.meaning_en: relating to the heart and blood vessels (cardi- heart + vascul- vessel + -ar relating to)
cards.usage_note: cardi- 是心，vascul- 是血管。词根能圈出系统，心衰、冠心病还是血管炎不能只靠构词当成同一个病。
cards.context_sentence: The cardiovascular system includes the heart, arteries, veins, and capillaries.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The heart-and-vessel system covers the pump plus the tubes that carry blood.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 心血管系统包括心脏、动脉、静脉和毛细血管。

cards.meaning_en: relating to lymph and its vessels or nodes (lymph- clear fluid + -atic relating to)
cards.usage_note: lymph- 是淋巴液，-atic 表示相关。词根能指系统，淋巴结肿大原因很多，不能只靠构词写成淋巴瘤。
cards.context_sentence: The lymphatic system returns fluid to the blood and helps immune defense.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The lymph network sends leftover fluid back into blood and supports immune defense.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 淋巴系统把组织液送回血液，并参与免疫防御。

cards.meaning_en: relating to blood circulation (circul- go around + -atory relating to a process)
cards.usage_note: circul- 是环行，-atory 表过程。词根是血液绕行全身。课堂常与心血管系统重叠，不能只靠构词区分两个术语。
cards.context_sentence: The circulatory system moves oxygen and nutrients to the tissues.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The circulating-blood system carries oxygen and food substances out to the tissues.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 循环系统把氧和营养送到组织。

cards.meaning_en: relating to breathing (re- again + spir- breathe + -atory process)
cards.usage_note: re- 是再，spir- 是呼吸。词根是气体交换过程。气促、哮喘还是肺炎不能只靠构词写成同一种病。
cards.context_sentence: The respiratory system brings oxygen in and expels carbon dioxide.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The breathing system takes oxygen in and sends carbon dioxide out.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 呼吸系统吸入氧气并排出二氧化碳。

cards.meaning_en: relating to urine and its pathway (urin- urine + -ary relating to)
cards.usage_note: urin- 是尿，-ary 表相关。词根圈出肾到尿道的通路。尿频原因很多，不能只靠构词当成尿路感染。
cards.context_sentence: The urinary system includes the kidneys, ureters, bladder, and urethra.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The urine pathway includes the kidneys, the tubes down to the bladder, and the exit tube.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 泌尿系统包括肾、输尿管、膀胱和尿道。

cards.meaning_en: secreting hormones into the blood (endo- inside + crine secrete)
cards.usage_note: endo- 是向内，crine 是分泌：激素入血，不是经导管排到体表。汗腺是外分泌，不能只靠构词混用。
cards.context_sentence: The endocrine system uses hormones to regulate growth and metabolism.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The inward-secreting gland system uses blood-borne messengers to control growth and energy use.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 内分泌系统用激素调节生长和代谢。

cards.meaning_en: relating to producing offspring (re- again + product- bring forth + -ive relating to)
cards.usage_note: re- 是再，product- 是产生。词根是生殖功能。课堂讲卵巢或睾丸时，不能只靠构词把所有盆腔痛写成生殖系统病。
cards.context_sentence: The reproductive system includes the ovaries, uterus, and testes.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The system for having children includes the ovaries, uterus, and testes.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 生殖系统包括卵巢、子宫和睾丸。

cards.meaning_en: relating to the stomach and intestines (gastro- stomach + intestin- bowel + -al relating to)
cards.usage_note: gastro- 是胃，intestin- 是肠。词根圈出消化管中段。呕吐、腹泻原因很多，不能只靠构词写成胃炎或肠炎。
cards.context_sentence: The gastrointestinal tract runs from the mouth to the rectum.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The stomach-and-bowel tube starts at the mouth and ends at the rectum.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 胃肠道从口腔延伸到直肠。

cards.meaning_en: inflammation of the mouth (stomat- mouth + -itis inflammation)
cards.usage_note: stomat- 是口，-itis 是炎症。词根能猜口腔黏膜发炎，病毒、义齿还是营养缺乏不能只靠构词定因。
cards.context_sentence: Painful stomatitis made it hard for the patient to eat solid food.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: A sore, inflamed mouth made chewing solid food difficult.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 疼痛性口炎使患者难以进固体食物。

cards.meaning_en: inflammation of the colon (col- large intestine + -itis inflammation)
cards.usage_note: col- 是结肠，-itis 是炎症。词根能猜大肠炎症，感染、缺血还是炎症性肠病不能只靠构词。
cards.context_sentence: Bloody diarrhea raised concern for infectious colitis.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Loose stools with blood made doctors worry the large bowel was inflamed by infection.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 血性腹泻使人担心感染性结肠炎。

cards.meaning_en: an organism that can cause disease (patho- disease + -gen that produces)
cards.usage_note: patho- 是疾病，-gen 是产生者。词根是“能致病的东西”。定植菌不一定致病，不能只靠构词把培养阳性写成感染。
cards.context_sentence: Hand washing reduces the spread of a common respiratory pathogen.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Washing hands lowers the chance of passing along a germ that can cause a breathing illness.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 洗手可减少常见呼吸道病原体的传播。

cards.meaning_en: having no symptoms (a- without + symptom + -atic relating to)
cards.usage_note: a- 是没有，后面是 symptom。词根是患者没感到不适。无症状不等于没病，筛查阳性仍要另解释，不能只靠构词。
cards.context_sentence: The infection was asymptomatic and found only on routine testing.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The person had no complaints; the infection showed up only on a routine test.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 感染并无症状，只在常规检测中发现。

cards.meaning_en: showing symptoms, or aimed at relieving them (symptom + -atic relating to)
cards.usage_note: 词根是“和症状有关”。symptomatic treatment 是对症，不是治因。有症状也不等于已确诊，不能只靠构词。
cards.context_sentence: Only symptomatic patients were advised to stay home and watch for worsening breath.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: People who already had complaints were told to remain home and notice if breathing got worse.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 有症状者被建议居家，并观察呼吸是否加重。

cards.meaning_en: a pause in breathing (a- without + -pnea breathing)
cards.usage_note: a- 是没有，-pnea 是呼吸。词根是暂时不喘气。睡眠呼吸暂停和心跳骤停时的无呼吸不是同一回事，不能只靠构词。
cards.context_sentence: Witnesses reported a short spell of apnea before the infant cried again.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: People who were there said the baby stopped breathing briefly and then cried again.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 目击者称婴儿在再次哭出声前有短暂呼吸暂停。

cards.meaning_en: lack of muscle tone (a- without + ton- tone + -ia condition)
cards.usage_note: a- 是没有，ton- 是张力。词根是肌肉松软。睡眠期正常肌弛缓和病理软瘫不是一回事，不能只靠构词当诊断。
cards.context_sentence: REM sleep normally brings muscle atonia except in the breathing muscles.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: During dream sleep the body muscles usually go slack, except the ones used to breathe.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 快速眼动睡眠期除呼吸肌外通常出现肌张力缺失。

cards.meaning_en: between acute and chronic in time course (sub- under/less than + acute sudden)
cards.usage_note: sub- 是低于、介于，acute 是急。词根是比急性慢、比慢性快。天数界限因病而异，不能只靠构词套用。
cards.context_sentence: A subacute cough lasting three weeks was reviewed in clinic.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: A cough that had lasted three weeks, neither sudden nor months-long, was checked in clinic.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 持续三周的亚急性咳嗽在门诊复查。

cards.meaning_en: a sudden rise of cases in a community (epi- upon + dem- people + -ic relating to)
cards.usage_note: epi- 是在上，dem- 是人群。词根是疾病压在一群人身上。地方性流行是 endemic，全球大流行是 pandemic，不能只靠构词混用。
cards.context_sentence: An influenza epidemic filled the pediatric ward in January.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: A sharp community wave of flu filled the children's ward in January.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 一月的流感流行挤满了儿科病房。

cards.meaning_en: always present in a particular place or people (en- in + dem- people + -ic relating to)
cards.meaning_zh: 地方性的；某地持续存在的
cards.usage_note: en- 是在内，dem- 是人群。词根是疾病常驻当地。突然暴发应写 epidemic，不能只靠构词把输入病例写成地方病。
cards.context_sentence: Malaria remains endemic in several tropical regions.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Malaria is still always present among people in several hot, wet regions.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 疟疾在若干热带地区仍呈地方性流行。

cards.meaning_en: a molecule that can trigger an immune response (anti- against + -gen that produces)
cards.usage_note: anti- 是对抗，-gen 是产生者：能引出抗体的东西。抗原阳性不等于正在生病，疫苗成分也是抗原，不能只靠构词。
cards.context_sentence: The rapid test detects influenza antigen in a nasal swab.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The quick test looks for a flu marker in a sample from the nose.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 快速检测从鼻拭子中检测流感抗原。

cards.meaning_en: an immune protein that binds a specific antigen (anti- against + body substance)
cards.usage_note: anti- 是对抗，body 是这种蛋白。词根是“对抗异物的蛋白”。IgM 和 IgG 时间不同，不能只靠构词判断新发还是既往。
cards.context_sentence: A positive antibody test showed past exposure rather than acute infection.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Finding the defense protein meant earlier contact, not necessarily a new infection right now.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 抗体阳性提示既往暴露，而不是急性感染。

cards.meaning_en: an antibody protein (immuno- immune + globulin globe-shaped protein)
cards.usage_note: immuno- 是免疫，globulin 是球形蛋白。IgG、IgA、IgM 功能不同，不能只靠构词把一项升高写成免疫缺陷或过敏。
cards.context_sentence: Serum immunoglobulin G was measured after repeated sinus infections.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The main antibody protein in blood was checked after many sinus infections.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 反复鼻窦感染后检测血清免疫球蛋白 G。

cards.meaning_en: a cell that engulfs particles or microbes (phago- eat + -cyte cell)
cards.usage_note: phago- 是吃，-cyte 是细胞。词根是会吞颗粒的细胞。中性粒细胞和巨噬细胞都算，不能只靠构词指定哪一种。
cards.context_sentence: A phagocyte can engulf bacteria and then digest them.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: An eating cell can take bacteria inside and then break them down.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 吞噬细胞可以吞入细菌并加以消化。

cards.meaning_en: progressive loss of normal cell or tissue quality (de- away + gener- kind/origin + -ation process)
cards.usage_note: de- 是离开，gener- 是正常类型。词根是组织变差。关节退变和神经变性不是同一病，不能只靠构词当诊断。
cards.context_sentence: Age-related degeneration of cartilage can narrow a joint space.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Wear-and-tear loss of cartilage quality can make the gap in a joint look narrower.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 年龄相关的软骨变性可使关节间隙变窄。

cards.meaning_en: failure to work normally (mal- bad + function working)
cards.usage_note: mal- 是不好，function 是工作。词根是“工作出差错”。器官衰竭比 malfunction 更重，不能只靠构词升级病情。
cards.context_sentence: Valve malfunction can let blood leak backward into the atrium.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: If a heart valve does not work properly, blood may leak back into the upper chamber.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 瓣膜功能障碍可使血液反流入心房。

cards.meaning_en: poor nutrition from too little, too much, or unbalanced intake (mal- bad + nutrition nourishment)
cards.usage_note: mal- 是不好，nutrition 是营养。词根是营养状态差，包括热量不足或比例失衡。体瘦不等于此诊断，不能只靠构词。
cards.context_sentence: Wound healing slowed because of protein-energy malnutrition.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The wound closed more slowly because the body was not getting enough protein and energy.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 蛋白质-能量营养不良使伤口愈合变慢。

cards.meaning_en: under the tongue (sub- under + lingu- tongue + -al relating to)
cards.usage_note: sub- 是在下，lingu- 是舌。词根是舌下给药或舌下腺。吞下去的口服药不是 sublingual，不能只靠构词。
cards.context_sentence: Nitroglycerin was given by the sublingual route for chest pain.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The chest-pain tablet was placed under the tongue so it could be absorbed there.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 胸痛时经舌下途径给予硝酸甘油。

cards.meaning_en: the flap above the glottis that helps keep food out of the airway (epi- upon + glottis voice opening)
cards.usage_note: epi- 是在上，glottis 是声门。词根是盖在声门上的结构。会厌炎是另一诊断，不能只靠构词把吞咽不适写成会厌炎。
cards.context_sentence: The epiglottis folds down during swallowing to protect the larynx.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The small flap above the voice box bends down while you swallow so food stays out of the airway.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 吞咽时会厌下折，保护喉入口。

cards.meaning_en: wave-like squeezing that moves contents along a tube (peri- around + stalsis constriction)
cards.usage_note: peri- 是环绕，stalsis 是缩窄。词根是管壁环形推进。肠鸣活跃不等于正常蠕动，梗阻时不能只靠构词判断。
cards.context_sentence: Normal peristalsis pushes chyme from the stomach into the duodenum.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Wave-like squeezing moves the partly digested food from the stomach into the first part of the small bowel.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 蠕动把食糜从胃推进十二指肠。

cards.meaning_en: the act of taking food or a substance into the mouth (in- in + gest- carry + -ion act)
cards.usage_note: in- 是进入，gest- 是运送。词根是把东西送进口。吸入是 inhalation，静脉给药不是 ingestion，不能只靠构词。
cards.context_sentence: Accidental ingestion of the cleaning liquid occurred at home.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The cleaning liquid was swallowed by mistake at home.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 清洁液在家中被误服摄入。

cards.meaning_en: relating to the heart (cardi- heart + -ac relating to)
cards.usage_note: cardi- 是心，-ac 表相关。词根能指定器官。胸痛不必是 cardiac，胃或肺来源也常见，不能只靠构词。
cards.context_sentence: Serial cardiac enzymes were drawn after the episode of chest pressure.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Heart-injury blood tests were taken after the spell of tightness in the chest.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 胸闷发作后抽了心肌酶。

cards.meaning_en: loss of the ability to move a part of the body (para- beside/abnormal + -lysis loosening)
cards.usage_note: para- 是异常，-lysis 是松解。词根提示运动能力松开。无力和完全不能动程度不同，不能只靠构词写成脊髓病。
cards.context_sentence: Sudden paralysis of the right arm required urgent imaging.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The right arm suddenly could not move, so emergency pictures of the brain and spine were needed.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 右臂突然瘫痪，需紧急影像检查。
